use IO.Std
use default

union Parsed is
    OK(value: double, at: int) default
    BAD(complaint: string)
si

let target = 24.0D

skip_spaces(text: string, at: int) -> int =>
    if at < text.length /\ text[at] == ' ' then
        skip_spaces(text, at + 1)
    else
        at
    fi

closed(text: string, value: double, at: int) -> Parsed =>
    (let close = skip_spaces(text, at)

     if close < text.length /\ text[close] == ')' then
         Parsed.OK(value, close + 1)
     else
         Parsed.BAD("a bracket is not closed")
     fi)

parse_atom(text: string, at: int) -> Parsed =>
    (let start = skip_spaces(text, at)

     if start >= text.length then
         Parsed.BAD("the expression ends too soon")
     elif char.is_digit(text[start]) then
         Parsed.OK(char.get_numeric_value(text[start]), start + 1)
     elif text[start] != '(' then
         Parsed.BAD("{text[start]} does not belong here")
     else
         case parse_sum(text, start + 1)
         when bad: Parsed.BAD then bad
         when inner: Parsed.OK then closed(text, inner.value, inner.at)
         esac
     fi)

apply(left: double, operator: char, right: double) -> double =>
    case operator
    when '+' then left + right
    when '-' then left - right
    when '*' then left * right
    else left / right
    esac

carry_on(
    text: string,
    value: double,
    at: int,
    operators: string,
    next: (string, int) -> Parsed
) -> Parsed =>
    (let operator_at = skip_spaces(text, at)

     if
         operator_at >= text.length \/
         !operators.contains("{text[operator_at]}")
     then
         Parsed.OK(value, at)
     else
         case next(text, operator_at + 1)
         when bad: Parsed.BAD then bad
         when step: Parsed.OK then
             carry_on(
                 text,
                 apply(value, text[operator_at], step.value),
                 step.at,
                 operators,
                 next
             )
         esac
     fi)

parse_run(
    text: string,
    at: int,
    operators: string,
    next: (string, int) -> Parsed
) -> Parsed =>
    case next(text, at)
    when bad: Parsed.BAD then bad
    when head: Parsed.OK then
        carry_on(text, head.value, head.at, operators, next)
    esac

parse_product(text: string, at: int) -> Parsed =>
    parse_run(text, at, "*/", parse_atom)

parse_sum(text: string, at: int) -> Parsed =>
    parse_run(text, at, "+-", parse_product)

sorted_digits(text: string) -> string =>
    (let held =
        text
            |> filter(letter => char.is_digit(letter))
            |> collect_array()

     System.Array.sort(held)

     string(held))

runs_digits_together(text: string) -> bool =>
    (0..text.length - 1)
        |> any(at =>
            char.is_digit(text[at]) /\ char.is_digit(text[at + 1]))

judge(entered: string, dealt: string) -> (told: string, solved: bool) =>
    if runs_digits_together(entered) then
        (told = "digits cannot be run together into longer numbers",
         solved = false)
    elif sorted_digits(entered) !~ sorted_digits(dealt) then
        (told = "use each of {dealt} exactly once", solved = false)
    else
        case parse_sum(entered, 0)
        when bad: Parsed.BAD then (told = bad.complaint, solved = false)
        when parsed: Parsed.OK then
            if skip_spaces(entered, parsed.at) < entered.length then
                (told = "the expression does not end there",
                 solved = false)
            elif System.Math.abs(parsed.value - target) < 0.000001D then
                (told = "that is 24, well done", solved = true)
            else
                (told = "that comes to {parsed.value}, not 24",
                 solved = false)
            fi
        esac
    fi

let random = System.Random(20260908)

let dealt =
    (0..4)
        |> map(_ => "123456789"[random.next(9)])
        |> join(" ")

Std.write_line("make 24 from {dealt}")
Std.write_line("use + - * / and brackets, each digit once, q to quit")

while true do
    Std.write("expression: ")

    let typed = Std.read_line()

    if !typed? \/ typed.trim().to_lower() =~ "q" then
        Std.write_line("goodbye")
        break
    fi

    let (told, solved) = judge(typed.trim(), dealt)

    Std.write_line(told)

    if solved then
        break
    fi
